DESCRIPTION.Common Locations.model_specs_readme_path: Path to the model specifications help document.
DESCRIPTION.Routers: Router entries keyed by user-defined router names. Add a router by adding an entry with all eight path fields. Names are dynamic; replace the example placeholders with your own names and paths.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>: Paths for the selected router. Values are file or directory paths as described below; ~ expands to the user home directory.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.specs: Path to the router model JSON specifications defining encryption, archive layout and editable fields.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.password: Path to the template password text file, read when the model requires a password.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.template: Path to the original encrypted router backup used for decoding and rebuilding.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.decoded_dir: Directory for the extracted decoded configuration.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.edited: Path to the edited .tar.gz archive created during encoding.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.edited_dir: Directory for the edited configuration copied from decoded_dir and used for encoding.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.encoded: Path to the newly encrypted router backup, verified by a local decryption round trip.
